listings.name: 6-Bed Mixed AC Dorm
listings.description: Located in the heart of Chennai, Zostel Chennai (Anna Nagar) brings together dorm-life buzz, quirky Kollywood art, chill zones. With Chennais top tourist spots just a metro ride away, its the perfect base for your city adventures. Tucked in the heart of Anna Nagar, one of Chennais swankiest neighbourhoods, Zostel Chennai (Anna Nagar) is your all-fun crash pad. From quirky Kollywood-inspired wall art to a buzzing common room for game nights and group chills, its got all the right vibes. Plus, it comes with only dorms, so backpacker vibes are guaranteed. Cosy corners? Check. Workation-friendly nooks? Absolutely. And if youre a caffeine fiend, the on-site caf only serves coffee (because in Chennai, thats all you really need). With cafs, metro stations, and top Chennai tourist places just around the corner, this Zostel is your ultimate launchpad for fun, food, and filter kaapi-fuelled adventures.
